prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application composition comp, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design composition option B for the Reoli Resume Forge main editor. Name it Split Galley. It is a premium Windows desktop tool for creating truthful ATS-friendly resumes.
Scene/backdrop: full application window, no device mockup, no browser chrome, straight-on UI screenshot.
Structure: a restrained 60px top command bar. The main workspace is a 42/58 split. On the left, a compact top row selects archetype and language; below it a tabless vertical editorial flow with Summary, Skills, Experience and Job Description separated by typography and hairlines rather than cards. A sticky ATS score ledger occupies the lower-left third: score 84/100, matched terms as quiet sage rows, missing terms as hollow rows. On the right, a large centered A4 page dominates a graphite pasteboard; slim proofing marks appear outside the page and a floating bottom export dock contains three familiar rectangular actions. Independent pane scrolling is visually clear.
Content: Use real product name “Reoli Resume Forge”; candidate “Pedro Lucas Reis”; role “Full Stack Engineer & Software Architect”; archetype “01_frontend”; actions “Exportar PDF”, “Exportar DOCX”, “Copiar Markdown”; score “84”; keywords React, TypeScript, Design Systems, Accessibility; Portuguese interface. Preview is a believable one-column ATS resume with real section headings but do not invent employers or career metrics.
Style/medium: high-fidelity UI comp, monochromatic dark tech / clean slate, shaped like a modern typesetter’s galley and editorial proofing app, not a generic SaaS dashboard. Matte black-green shell, charcoal panels, warm-white document, pale mineral green only for selected and matched states. One workhorse grotesk for UI; monospaced numerals only for score, page measures and keyboard shortcuts.
Composition/framing: the paper page is the dominant quiet object; left pane feels like one continuous editorial instrument, not stacked rounded cards. Dense enough for professional daily use, generous enough to read.
Lighting/mood: crisp, flat interface lighting; serious, precise, calm.
Color palette: #0D100F, #151917, #202622, #E9ECE8, #A0C3AF, #7F8983.
Materials/textures: matte shell, very subtle warm paper grain, 1px rules, gentle vertical depth at the split only.
Text (verbatim where prominent): “Reoli Resume Forge”, “01_frontend”, “Resumo”, “Competências”, “Experiência”, “Descrição da vaga”, “84 / 100”, “Exportar PDF”, “Exportar DOCX”, “Copiar Markdown”, “Pedro Lucas Reis”, “Full Stack Engineer & Software Architect”.
Constraints: desktop operating surface, no marketing hero; no gradients; no neon; no glassmorphism; no bento cards; no circular progress ring; no decorative charts; no emoji; no fake logos; no laptop mockup; no watermark; do not show fake company names or fabricated years of experience. Familiar controls, visible keyboard focus and plausible 44px interactions.
mustNotLiteralize: contact values shown in the comp
